top_signals.title: Nvidia Probes Huang Affair Amid Spying Controversy
top_signals.summary: Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang says he is cooperating fully with an independent board investigation after admitting to an extramarital relationship. The inquiry follows US intelligence suspicions that a female executive was recruited by a Chinese intelligence agency. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
